gate.unavailableBody: Connectors are for tenant admins, editors, and integrators. Your role cannot open this catalog.
gate.needsTenantBody: Connector profiles are tenant-scoped. Select a concrete tenant in the sidebar — All Tenants is not supported here.

catalog.subtitle: Connector families and their operations. HTTP profiles hold optional basic-auth; URL, headers, query, and body stay on the Service Task.
catalog.emptyDescription: The default proxy currently lists the HTTP family.

operations.title: Operations
operations.subtitle: Operator ids and parameters a Service Task can bind.

profiles.subtitle: Saved credential sets a Service Task can select by name.
profiles.emptyAllTenants: No profiles yet. Select a tenant to add one.
profiles.emptyManage: No profiles yet. Add one to select it from a Service Task.
profiles.emptyReadOnly: No profiles available. Contact your administrator to create a connector profile.
profiles.deleteDescription: This removes "{{name}}" and its stored credentials. Any process model that still selects this profile will fail when it runs. Deactivate instead if you may need it again.

edit.notAllowedBody: Your role can open Connectors but cannot create or edit a profile.
edit.subtitleAdd: Secret values are encrypted when saved and are never shown again.
edit.subtitleEdit: Credentials are never shown. Use Replace to change one.
edit.identifierHelpAdd: Generated from the display name (3-50 characters). Service Tasks select this profile by it, and it cannot be changed later.
edit.identifierHelpEdit: Service Tasks select this profile by its identifier. It cannot be changed.
edit.descriptionPlaceholder: What this profile is for, e.g. which environment it targets.
edit.valueSaved: Leave blank to keep the saved value.
edit.stripeLive: Live mode key. Payments made with this profile are real.
edit.stripeTest: Test mode key. No real money moves.

unsaved.title: Discard unsaved changes?
unsaved.description: You have changes to this profile that have not been saved.

validation.port: Enter a port number between 1 and 65535.
validation.identifierNoAlnum: The display name must contain at least one letter or number.
validation.identifierTaken: A profile with the identifier "{{identifier}}" already exists. Choose a different display name.
validation.identifierInUse: This identifier is already in use.
